title: Query parameters
intro: The query has parameters. Each value is written into the text as an engine literal, with the right quotes; on the right you can see how it ends up.

invalid.date: Write the date as YYYY-MM-DD, with optional time (hh:mm or hh:mm:ss).

disable: Not parameters: run the text as is
disableTip: For when :name is the engine's own syntax and not a parameter: runs the text as is and stops looking for parameters in this tab. It can be turned back on from the editor menu.
remember: Don't ask again in this tab: use these values
rememberTip: The next runs in this tab use these values without opening this window; it only asks for a new parameter. Change them from “Edit parameters…” in the editor menu.
